name: resolve_birthplace
description: Resolve city/country to coordinates. May query configured external geocoder. Never select ambiguous places.

name: calculate_natal_chart
description: Calculate literal-time tropical chart. Supply confirmed coordinates to avoid external geocoding. No UTC/DST conversion; exact clock does not mean verified instant.

name: calculate_transits
description: Planet positions and mutual aspects at a literal conventional UT reference, not natal-to-transit synastry.

name: calculate_aspects
description: Deterministic major aspects from supplied 0 <= longitudes < 360. Default orbs 8/4/6/6/8 degrees.

name: get_ephemeris
description: Swiss planetary positions with pinned data provenance; literal conventional UT, not verified UTC.
